gaps.sentence: She's having her wedding dress ___ by a tailor in Naples.
gaps.explanation: Have + object + past participle: having her dress made by a professional.

gaps.sentence: I must get my passport ___ (renew) before the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Get + object + past participle': the passport is renewed by an authority, not by me.

gaps.sentence: All new students ___ (give) a locker key on their first day.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive: are + given. Passives of give keep the indirect object as subject.

gaps.sentence: The rare print ___ (steal) from the locked cabinet — the lock wasn't forced.
gaps.explanation: Perfect modal passive: must have been + past participle for a confident past deduction.

gaps.sentence: This form ___ (sign) in ink — digital signatures aren't valid.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: modal + be + past participle. Obligation: must (also has to) be signed.

gaps.sentence: My laptop ___ (service) next week, so back up your files beforehand.
gaps.explanation: 'Next week' takes the future passive: will be + serviced (is being serviced is also a valid arrangement).

gaps.sentence: The house ___ badly since the owner emigrated.
The letters ___ while the family was on holiday.
gaps.explanation: Ongoing during the holiday: past continuous passive were being + opened.
